title: Moon first.
caption:
Karwa Chauth runs in a fixed order. The moon through the chalni, then his face, then the first sip of water.

This ring only had room for two of those: a round ball for the moon, a long teardrop for the water. He will understand. The Droplet Open Ring, ₹1,299, in silver tone or gold tone, open at the back, so it adjusts from US 5 to 8.

Order tonight and it arrives after the moon. Some things are worth the wait.

Today's mangal: Punjabi, ਮੰਗਲ.

[ droplet open ring · rhodium silver tone or 18k gold tone plated · moon, water, him ]
alt_text: Slide 1: on a deep plum night with a few small gold stars, a drawn steel sieve with a scalloped gold lace edge glows like the moon. In its mesh sits a real silver-tone open ring, shown larger than life, with a round ball at one end, labelled the moon, and a teardrop at the other, labelled the first sip. Text: House rule 01, Karwa Chauth. Moon first. Then him. Then the first sip of water. At the foot, the Naira wordmark and the word Mangal, in English and in Punjabi, beside a small steel key.

Slide 2: the silver-tone Droplet Open Ring on a cream plaster block, its round ball and long teardrop side by side. On a plum band: Only room for two. He will understand. Droplet Open Ring, silver tone, 1,299 rupees. Rhodium silver tone plated, open, fits US 5 to 8.

Slide 3: the same ring in gold tone, standing upright on the plaster block. On a blush band: Or in gold tone. Same moon, warmer. Droplet Open Ring, gold tone, 1,299 rupees. 18K gold tone plated, open, fits US 5 to 8.

s1 'the first sip' starts at x 810, not the AD's x 800, on the shared baseline 1080. Measured ink: 'the moon' ends 18 px from its leader. At x 800 the t of 'the first sip' was 7.7 px from its leader and read as touching it. At 810 the two labels mirror each other about x 540 (270 / 810) and both sit 18 px from their leader.
s1 'shown larger.' moves into the diagram: right-aligned to x 270, baseline 1118, under 'the moon' (spec: x 60, baseline 1170, where it read as a stray caption).
s1 leaders carry a 7 px plum (#3B2D4A) casing on the same path. On the pale steel rim the 2 px gold measured about 1.4:1 and disappeared at the crossing.

s1: a faint moonlight halo outside the chalni: cream #FBF3EC at 10% at r 340, fading to 0 at r 470. The spec's r 330 glow lies entirely under the mesh and the rim. The grid tile still reads as dark plum.

s1 uses a cleaned copy of the cut-out, render/option-b/p02/assets/droplet-open-ring-01-clean.png (798x537, alpha unchanged). Its outer 2 px carried the old cream plaster, which showed as a light rim on plum, so they take their colour from the metal 3 px inside. Fix pass 3 (p02tools/retouch_foot.py), with the AD's zones read as slide (1080x1440) coordinates and mapped through the 450x303, -6 deg placement: on the band's flat foot under the ball (x 400-560, y 860-914) and the band's lower outer edge (x 323-420, y 800-880) the plaster grain is softened with an edge-preserving surface blur (bilateral, about 3 px), the cast is pulled to the ball's (foot R-B 16.1 to 11.1; edge 12.5 to 10.7) and the luminance lowered 8% (foot Y 198.9 to 182.8, edge 218.3 to 201.0). Small departures from 'in those zones only': the foot box runs on to y 930 so the treatment reaches the foot's own bottom silhouette rather than stopping in a line across it; the edge strip runs on to y 905 so the two treated areas meet; inside the edge zone only the outer 14-20 px of the tube is treated, so the tube's highlight keeps its shape; and where a zone edge crosses open metal (the foot box's top edge left of the ball, its right edge under the ball) the treatment fades in from 4 px outside the box to 18 px inside, because a hard edge left an 8% luminance step that showed as a seam at 2x. Fringe: along the band's top contour (x 330-745, y 633-662) and in both zones the edge recolour is widened from 2 px to 3 px (the AD's second option; the alpha is not eroded, so the ring keeps its exact size and the leader clearances hold). On the top contour the outer 3 px went from R-B 15.7, Y 205 to R-B 14.8, Y 200, the same as the 4th pixel in. The ball and the teardrop are untouched: 0 pixels changed in either.

Size truth: the live listing's 5th image (droplet-open-ring-size-guide.jpg, fetched from the Shopify CDN 25 Oct) reads 'Teardrop 6.6 mm · open, fits US 5 to 8' and 'Measurements are approximate, give or take 1 mm'. No millimetre figure appears on any slide, in the caption or in the alt text. The fit claim is the guide's own words, 'open, fits US 5 to 8', and the caption says 'adjusts from US 5 to 8' (tag Adjustable).

Claims, all from tags: 'silver tone' and 'gold tone' are colours only; 'RHODIUM SILVER TONE PLATED' (s2) and '18K GOLD TONE PLATED' (s3) are the product's tags. Waterproof, tarnish-free and hypoallergenic are tagged but not used. No bare gold or silver, no metal content, no Karwa Chauth date, no delivery date, no code, no percentage. No em dash, exclamation mark, emoji or urgency on the images or in the caption.

Concept: the cover labels two of the three rituals on the ring (the ball, the moon; the teardrop, the first sip) and leaves 'then him.' unlabelled. s2 pays it off in the band, 'ONLY ROOM FOR TWO.' then 'he will understand.', and the caption repeats that line. s3 offers the gold tone ('same moon, warmer.') on the same type grid, so nothing jumps on the swipe.
